verdict.rationale: Numeral's marketing claims it will "Register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions" and pricing page lists "Autofile and Autoregister" as a feature, indicating registration is handled in-product, but there is no evidence of per-registration pricing transparency or a dedicated registration status-tracking UI/API object (only nexus, filings, and certificate objects are documented). Missing for 10: explicit per-registration pricing breakdown, a documented registration status-tracking object/endpoint, and independent confirmation the registration filing actually completes end-to-end.
